category_insight: OCHO is one of a CLUSTER: small (14-50 unit) freehold en-bloc redevelopments concentrated in Geylang / Joo Chiat / Telok Kurau / Amber. These ARE the freehold new-launch supply on the east side. Two structural issues for the brief: (1) the budget-fitting ones (Geylang: MORI, Gems Ville, likely OCHO at ~S$1,680-2,000 psf) sit in Geylang/Aljunied, NOT Eunos/Paya Lebar, and sell out fast due to tiny unit counts; (2) the prime-location ones (Joo Chiat/Katong/Amber/Meyer/Tanjong Rhu at ~S$2,400-3,300 psf) price a >=1,000 sqft 3BR ABOVE S$2.2M. The large upcoming D19 projects (Chuan Park, Chuan Grove, Hougang Central) are all 99-year and above band.
